g.text: P1-401 SERVO AUGER FILLER: DRAWING SET
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Servo auger filler P1-401, built in house, 1 off, rev B
42 L hopper on a 4 in column over a controls cabinet; 750 W servo auger, 2 tooling sets, 4-position container stage, 15 doses/min rated
dose the finished blend into shakers 113 g, jars and pouches 340 g, tubs 2268 g
316L Ø450, 42.2 L, cone 57°, 2.5 in TC outlet, split lid with interlocked scoop flap
SureServo2 750 W, HTD belt 2:1, spindle on 2 x 6205 in a cartridge; J 600 rpm, S 900 rpm
1/4 HP gearmotor, #40 SS chain 2:1, 30 rpm, hub on 2 x 6008 around the spindle
S 27 OD (shakers), J 46 OD (jars, pouches, tubs), LH M16 x 1.5 top thread
4 heights on 2 Ø20 rods, index plunger, container sensor (no container, no dose)
CLICK PLUS PLC, 3 in HMI, PNOZ s4 safety relay (E-stop + flap → STO), foot switch start
208 V 1-ph 20 A + PE; Ethernet to the MES
top 760, outlet 1020 AFF; footprint 640 x 640 + column; hopper rim 1590
cartridge loads from the top with spacers; 12 mm cap; 750 VA control transformer; cabinet moved 200 back
P1-401 SERVO AUGER FILLER: DRAWING SET
SECTIONS AND DETAILS: DRIVE HEAD, OUTLET, RIM, STAGE INDEX
CABINET WELDMENT (BASE OF THE FILLER, CONTROLS INSIDE)
CABINET SHEET METAL: FLAT PATTERNS AND BEND DATA
HOPPER WELDMENT 42 L, LID AND FLAP (PRODUCT CONTACT)
BOUGHT PARTS, HARDWARE AND RAW MATERIAL
ELECTRICAL: POWER (208 V 1-PH, 120 V, 24 V DC)
ELECTRICAL: SAFETY CIRCUIT, CONTROL 24 V, PLC I/O
ELECTRICAL: PANEL LAYOUT, WIRE LIST, CABLES
INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
1. Units mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Tolerances in the title block unless noted. Weld symbols AWS A2.4; welding to AWS D18.1 / ASME BPE MJ.
2. Product-contact parts 316L, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm, welds ground flush, passivated ASTM A967. Seals FDA 21 CFR 177.2600; bearing grease NSF H1.
3. Cut files (DXF) in dxf/ in mm and inch; 3D: cad/ (STEP per part, P1-401-ASM.step/.glb); generator: design.py, model.py, sh_*.py.
4. Bought parts marked 'confirm' must be checked against the supplier drawing before the matching made part is cut (servo flange, gearmotor face, auger thread).
5. Release for build: drawings checked, ITP P1-401-900 attached to the traveler, materials certified.
